import { cloneElement, useId, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactElement } from "react"; export function Field({ label, description, error, required, children, className = "", ...props }: HTMLAttributes & { label: string; description?: string; error?: string; required?: boolean; children: ReactElement<{ id?: string; required?: boolean; "aria-describedby"?: string; "aria-invalid"?: boolean }> }) { const generated = useId(); const id = children.props.id ?? generated; const describedBy = error ? `${id}-error` : description ? `${id}-description` : undefined; const control = cloneElement(children, { id, required, "aria-describedby": describedBy, "aria-invalid": Boolean(error) }); return
{control}{description && !error &&

{description}

{error}

}
; }
